description: One look-and-say step on a digit string. 1 becomes 11, and 1211 becomes 111221. Two 2s become 22. An empty string, or a character that is not a digit, is rejected. The string stops at 4096 characters. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-step
name: look_say_step
title: Look Say Step
